detaileddescription.para: This module contains the CANOPY_BIOP subroutine which provides biogenic emission factors and parameters from MEGAN2.1 (Model of Emissions of Gases and Aerosols from Nature). The module contains extensive parameter tables for different biogenic volatile organic compounds (BVOCs) and vegetation types.
